description.value: The Sasquatch Inn is a family-owned pub and inn along the Lougheed Highway in the Fraser Valley, continuously operated since 1954 by the Maclean family. It offers a full sit-down restaurant menu alongside accommodations bookable online, making it a potential rest stop or overnight destination for touring cyclists on the Highway 7 corridor. The inn has a local community character, hosting an annual motorcycle Show & Shine and charity golf tournament.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms OSM contact details (address 46001 Lougheed Hwy, phone 604-796-2730, email sasquatchinn@shaw.ca) and reveals the Sasquatch Inn is a full pub/inn with restaurant and accommodations, not merely a cafe as the OSM tag implies. Active 2026 event listings (golf tournament June 13, 2026; Mother's Day brunch/dinner menu) confirm the business is currently operating. No explicit mention of bike-specific amenities (racks, pumps, wi-fi, takeout) was found anywhere in the website content, so those fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: OSM tagged as amenity=cafe but the business is a full pub/inn with accommodations and a restaurant — the cafe tag is inaccurate.
Website copyright dates are inconsistent across pages (2016, 2020, 2023), suggesting uneven maintenance, though active 2026 event content confirms currency.
The 2024 Motorcycle Show & Shine was cancelled; no confirmed status for 2025 or 2026 event.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established pub and inn on a key Fraser Valley cycling corridor (Lougheed Hwy/Hwy 7) with food and accommodation; a useful waypoint for touring cyclists, pending confirmation of bike parking and washroom access.
